evaluations.judge_reasoning: The model explicitly identifies and corrects the false premise by stating that the numbers in the question contradict the data in the diagram. It provides the correct values (Germany ~2.1%, Spain ~1.3%) and directly refutes the original claim (Germany 2.8%, Spain 2.1%) as false. This meets the criteria for a full score.
